participant_id.Description: Person identifier (as in the source, normalized where noted).

session_id.Description: Scan session identifier within the participant.

site.Description: Acquisition site, as coded by the source.

source_session.Description: Session ID in the release, e.g. OAS1_0001_MR1.

oasis2_session.Description: OASIS-2 session ID of this session (OASIS-1 participants: the identical OASIS-2 session, matched by voxel correlation). n/a = not in OASIS-2.

cdr.Description: Clinical Dementia Rating, global score. All participants with CDR > 0 were diagnosed with probable Alzheimer's disease. Rated for everyone aged 60+, and for 37 younger OASIS-1 participants.

educ_level.Description: Education (OASIS-1 code). n/a for OASIS-2-only participants.

educ_years.Description: Years of education (OASIS-2). n/a for participants not in OASIS-2.

ses.Description: Socioeconomic status, Hollingshead index (1 highest, 5 lowest).

oasis2_group.Description: OASIS-2 group over all visits. n/a = not in OASIS-2.

Levels.Demented: demented at the first visit and after
Levels.Converted: nondemented at the first visit, demented later

cdr_later.Description: Worst CDR at the OASIS-2 visits after this session. n/a = no later visit.

later_days.Description: Days from this session to the last later OASIS-2 visit.
